label: Tech Ember Fest: top 3 win festival tickets
note: The first major. The top 3 on the standings each win a solo ticket. Twenty games, so there is something for everyone and one lucky game can't decide it. It ends six days before the festival, so winners get their tickets in time.

major.title: Tech Ember Fest Major
major.tagline: Twenty games, two weeks. The top 3 each win a ticket to Tech Ember Fest, Lagos, on 5 December.
major.about: Tech Ember Fest is a day outdoors with games, music, food and the people behind Lagos tech: Saturday 5 December 2026, 4 PM to 11 PM, at Crystal Park, Ozone, Yaba. You don't need to work in tech to have a good time.

prizes.prize: A solo ticket to Tech Ember Fest (worth ₦20,000)
